title: Board Play Camera Ease After Play
description: After redraw play stops, avoid instant camera jump: hold 1s then ease cameras to triptych fit over 2s (smoothstep). Suppress camera basis tick during animation.
summary: After redraw play stops, camera no longer snaps to triptych: hold pinned cameras 1s, then 2s smoothstep blend (slow–fast–slow) of all three pane cameras toward fresh triptych from current fixture; exponential zoom interpolation. Suppress camera-basis tick bumps during ease; cancel pending ease on play restart. Settings blurb updated.
